name: themespot
description: ThemeSpot gives Claude the tools and context to build, migrate and maintain a HubSpot website: theme development on ThemeSpot UI, website migration, and ongoing maintenance, through ThemeSpot's hosted MCP server. Works alongside HubSpot's own connector. Sign in with your ThemeSpot account; nothing to install.
